class.name: genie_sim_rviz_plugins/ViewCameraPosePublisher
class.description: Publishes the active RViz 3D view's camera pose as geometry_msgs/PoseStamped on a configurable topic. Intended to drive the headless OVRTX render node's FreeCam so the off-screen render mirrors the user's interactive RViz viewpoint. An optional independent std_msgs/Float64 topic controls Newton inline OVRtx optical zoom and can follow Orbit-controller mouse-wheel distance changes automatically.
